items.title: Security Breach Pumpkin Madness Contest
items.summary: The Security Breach Pumpkin Madness contest was the first pumpkin carving event held by Steel Wool Studios from October 15, 2021, to October 31, 2021, promoting Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach.

items.summary: The hardmode animatronics are recolored animatronic counterparts who appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted, exclusive to blacklight modes.

items.title: Michael Schmidt (Film)
items.summary: Michael "Mike" Schmidt is the main protagonist of the Five Nights at Freddy's film series.  He is a poor man who decides to take the job as night-shift security guard for the abandoned Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Place.
